$comment: Native components of pipeline pack 0.4.0 (M10 G1), one pinned recipe each, built by build-native.mjs for Windows x64 and macOS arm64 (decision 8; Intel Macs keep the other pipelines). `cmake` are the options each build passes; `require` are the values the native licence gate then reads back from the build's CMakeCache.txt; `includes` are the third-party parts compiled into a component (for the notices). `status`: required (the build fails without it), deferred (recipe not built in this pack, with the reason).

vcpkg.why: The baseline of COLMAP 4.2.1's own vcpkg-configuration.json, the set its CI builds with

components.name: colmap

pycolmap.$comment: The wheel builds with --no-build-isolation in the build Python: `buildRequires` are installed there first, pinned, and must cover every [build-system] requires of the source's pyproject.toml except `notInstalled` (with the reason). `repair` bundles the native libraries into the wheel. Build-time only: none of them ships, except pybind11's headers (listed in includes).

notInstalled.ruff: formats the type stubs only; GENERATE_STUBS=OFF
notInstalled.clang-format: formats the type stubs only; GENERATE_STUBS=OFF

includes.name: pycolmap
includes.note: Python bindings, built from the same tree as a cp313 wheel

includes.name: PoseLib
includes.note: FetchContent, pinned by SHA-256 in COLMAP's src/thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt

includes.name: faiss
includes.note: FetchContent, pinned by SHA-256; CPU only, no MKL

includes.name: VLFeat (SIFT)
includes.note: Vendored in COLMAP; SIFT's patent expired in March 2020

includes.name: PoissonRecon
includes.note: Vendored in COLMAP, compiled without CHOLMOD

components.excluded: LSD (AGPL-3.0, LSD_ENABLED=OFF), SiftGPU (non-commercial, needs OpenGL or CUDA, both OFF), CGAL (GPL-3.0, CGAL_ENABLED=OFF), CHOLMOD and SPQR (GPL, CHOLMOD_ENABLED=OFF with our patch and ceres without suitesparse), curl and OpenSSL (DOWNLOAD_ENABLED=OFF), Qt (GUI_ENABLED=OFF), ONNX Runtime and learned features (ONNX_ENABLED=OFF)

components.name: opencv-python-headless
components.probe: After the build, the wheel is installed with probeRequires into a scratch folder and cv2.getBuildInformation() must report no videoio module, no FFmpeg or GStreamer backend, no Intel IPP and no non-free code; build-native.mjs also reads `require` back from _skbuild/<platform>/cmake-build/CMakeCache.txt, OpenCV's own cache.
components.excluded: FFmpeg and GStreamer (videoio off: the PyPI wheels bundle LGPL and, on macOS arm64, GPL codecs), Intel IPP-ICV (Intel Simplified Software License), the non-free modules, DNN, G-API

components.name: pdal
components.note: The PDAL command-line tool into <pack>/tools/pdal, which aio_pipelines/pointcloud.py looks for; no plugins (the port's plugin features are off, and PDAL's test plugin fauxplugin, which it always builds, is left out when build-native.mjs copies the tool), PROJ without network

components.name: poissonrecon
components.note: PoissonRecon and SurfaceTrimmer for photo/mesh.py (G3), found at <pack>/tools/poissonrecon or AIO_POISSONRECON and AIO_SURFACETRIMMER. Built by our CMake project (poissonrecon/CMakeLists.txt) from upstream's sources; no version tags after V8, so pinned by commit (Version 8.76, 29 Apr 2026). zlib, libpng and libjpeg-turbo come from vcpkg (poissonrecon/vcpkg.json, static; ports checked by the licence gate) instead of the copies vendored upstream, which are not compiled: their zlib does not build under C99 with current AppleClang and their libpng is 1.2.29. Our patch reads the PNG row width through libpng 1.6's API.

components.name: texrecon
components.why: Recipe only (G3's photo/texture.py has the full recipe and falls back to its own texturing): mvs-texturing with RESEARCH=OFF (no research-only gco), Eigen from vcpkg eigen3 with EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY instead of the Eigen 3.3.2 tarball its elibs/CMakeLists.txt downloads, TBB, libpng, libjpeg-turbo and libtiff from vcpkg, mapMAP at fa526e0 (BSD-3-Clause, dset Zlib) and rayint (BSD-3-Clause; fetched from the `cuda` branch, to be pinned by commit). Not built in this round: it needs MVE's libraries built first (ODM's superbuild supplies them; upstream MVE builds with Makefiles and has no Windows build). Install into <pack>/tools/texrecon (AIO_TEXRECON).

components.name: mve
components.why: dmrecon, scene2pset and fssrecon are one of G3's CPU dense options; G3's spike chooses between MVE and OpenCV StereoSGBM (already in this pack). Built here only if the spike picks MVE.

components.name: opensfm
components.why: Only for G2's spike against COLMAP; shipped only if the spike picks it (its fpdf2, opencv-python and OpenMVS exporter dependencies would be removed).
